description:
A multiplayer environment for coding with teammates and agents.

Delta brings teammates and coding agents into one shared thread. Your conversations and code live in the same place, and every change is anchored to the reasoning behind it, so the decisions and prompts that produced the code stay readable alongside the results.
Work in the Delta app or from your terminal; DeltaDB keeps both in the same thread. The version control system records every edit with the conversation behind it, and a thread shared from Claude Code can be joined from the Delta app, and the other way around.
Invite teammates into the same thread to review, comment, and work alongside the agent in real time. Comment on the conversation or any line of code, and the feedback stays anchored as the work evolves.
🔧 Fixes and reliability
- Fixed Delta Web showing a black screen in Safari 26.
